Body Text:
This year has been about showing more of what we’ve always done quietly.

About letting you see the process and not just the product.

In a time where it’s hard to know what’s real,
we felt the need to come closer, not louder.

Hydrosols have been in process for long time. 

I’ve always believed we had to do things differently.
But what I’ve learned is, it’s not about being different, it’s about being honest and always sticking to what we believe in. 

About staying close to the land, the season, and the way things are meant to be made.

This feels like that.

Why take the train when you can drive through the heart of history? 🚗🇪🇬

Most visitors rush between Aswan and Luxor, but the real magic is in the stops most people miss. As a travel professional, I always recommend the desert road for a “once-in-a-lifetime” perspective.

✨ Edfu: Standing before the massive pylon of the Temple of Horus. It’s so well-preserved you feel like you’ve stepped back 2,000 years.

✨ Gebel el-Silsila: Passing the very quarries that built the Great Temples.

✨ Kom Ombo: The unique “Double Temple” for the Falcon God and the Crocodile God.

From mummified crocodiles to ancient surgical tools and the “Nile-o-meter” (an ancient tax calculator!), this route is the ultimate deep dive into how advanced this civilization truly was.

.
🎼 Also, I’ve got some new equipment on the way that should make creating & recording music a lot easier! I’m ecstatic about upgrading my setup & can’t wait to step it up for y’all! 😸 
.
🎸 Feels like I’m finally doing what I’ve always loved & wanted to do.  Don’t get me wrong, I still love veterinary medicine & I wanna continue contributing to that field.  However, when it comes to my more creative endeavors… I just needed to build up the confidence to pursue them & that confidence is finally here! What a freeing feeling it is! 🎨
.
🐾 Though you can connect with all sorts of creatures through vet med, I’ve always appreciated that art & music offer a different kind of connection. Whether it’s visual or auditory, sometimes creative works convey emotions when words alone fall short.  That’s what has made me fall absolutely in love with those two fields.  I feel incredibly lucky to both create & experience them! 🥰
.
❤️‍🔥 For all y’all art and/or music lovers out there, what made you fall in love? 💬
.
